## Shortlist for grading

60 PRs chosen by a mechanical rank: not draft first, then a title or label keyword hit, then smallest diff, among PRs updated since 2026-10-18 with at most 400 changed lines. Summaries are from the PR body (first ~1500 characters); "screenshots/video" means the body mentions them or embeds media.

- [#23404](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23404) fix(server): Expo projects show their app icon · `Nils-Fischer` · +1/-0 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Expo projects from the default `create-expo-app` template show a letter monogram instead of the app icon, because the favicon resolver never checks `assets/images/icon.png`. The fix adds that path to the lookup.
- [#22742](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22742) fix(mobile): hide Android draft native header before first layout · `juliusmarminge` · +1/-0 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: no · attribution: none
  Android new-task draft hides its native header from the first render (`headerShown: Platform.OS !== "android"`), so the header no longer affects the initial layout before the Material toolbar draws.
- [#24484](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24484) fix(mobile): dismiss keyboard interactively while dragging chat · `JamesOBrien2` · +1/-1 · updated 2026-10-25 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Mobile thread feed sets `keyboardDismissMode` to `interactive`, so dragging the chat while the prompt keyboard is open dismisses it on iOS and Android.
- [#24260](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24260) fix(web): usage limit toast shows the Limited icon · `fixfon` · +2/-0 · updated 2026-10-25 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  The usage-limit toast shows the blue 'Input needed' icon; the leading-icon logic is extended to the `limited` state so it matches the orange Limited indicator in the sidebar.
- [#24209](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24209) fix(web): name the sidebar logo link T3 Code home · `shivamhwp` · +1/-1 · updated 2026-10-24 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  The sidebar logo link's accessible name changes from 'Go to threads' to 'T3 Code home', so screen-reader and voice-control users hear the visible branding. Visuals and destination are unchanged.
- [#24042](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24042) fix(shared): PASS and FAIL badges stay readable in dark command output · `WesleySmits` · +1/-1 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Badge text on coloured backgrounds (e.g. PASS/FAIL) picks near-black or white by the WCAG 3:1 rule, but the luminance threshold disagrees with it, leaving some dark-palette backgrounds with unreadable text.
- [#22605](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22605) fix(web): show the thread details toggle tooltip · `otavio` · +1/-1 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  The thread details toggle in the chat header gets its missing tooltip, so its `threadPanel.toggle` shortcut is surfaced. The toggle switches between PopoverTrigger and a plain Toggle depending on presentation.
- [#23401](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23401) fix(mobile): use monospace in the Android terminal preview · `only21mil` · +1/-1 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with GPT-6.1 Sol in T3 Code Nightly
  The Android terminal font-size preview in Settings > Appearance > Terminal uses `Menlo`, which Android lacks; it switches to Android's system monospace so the sample is judgeable.
- [#22002](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22002) fix(desktop): clear Cache Storage when deleting browser profile data · `only21mil` · +1/-1 · updated 2026-10-21 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Opus 5.5 in T3 Code Nightly
  Clearing a desktop browser profile's cookies and cache (and removing the profile) does not clear Cache Storage; the existing clear path is extended to Cache Storage.
- [#22348](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22348) fix(web): let theme color pickers use popover glass · `UtkarshUsername` · +1/-1 · updated 2026-10-20 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  The theme color picker paints an opaque `bg-popover` over the shared glass popover, so it stays solid when Glass opacity is lowered. Removing the inner background lets the popover own its tint, blur and border for every theme color role.
- [#22417](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22417) fix(mobile): iOS sheets scroll to the end and keep their buttons on screen · `Claudesaul` · +2/-1 · updated 2026-10-20 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  On iOS the Terminal output sheet cannot scroll to its last line and Attach sits below the edge, because the FormSheet host does not bound flex children; the Android fix (#20284) is applied to the shared iOS sheet.
- [#21548](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/21548) fix(mobile): iOS HTML file previews start below the header · `nabettu` · +3/-0 · updated 2026-10-19 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  On iOS, HTML files opened from the Files screen start under the status bar and transparent header; the file-preview WebView's `contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior` is set to `automatic`.
- [#24541](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24541) fix(android): keep navigation rail controls steady across tabs · `PixPMusic` · +4/-0 · updated 2026-10-24 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  On Android, hiding the compose button on other tabs shifts every rail destination upward; an equal-height spacer keeps the destinations centred on collapsed and expanded rails.
- [#23797](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23797) fix(mobile): expanded HTML pages start below the header on iOS · `Claudesaul` · +3/-1 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  On iOS, an expanded agent HTML page opens with its top under the header and a gap below; the full-screen WebView inset is set directly because the `automaticallyAdjustContentInsets` prop does nothing for WKWebView.
- [#20144](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/20144) fix(ios): iPad sidebar tabs no longer stick on the wrong tab · `PixPMusic` · +4/-0 · updated 2026-10-21 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  On iPad the Threads / Pull requests segment in the sidebar drifts out of sync on each round trip, because SwiftUI thinks the segment is already selected; the selection is synced so the list and highlight agree.
- [#22436](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22436) fix(web): show the platform modifier in the send tooltip · `UtkarshUsername` · +2/-2 · updated 2026-10-20 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  The send button tooltip shows `Ctrl/⌘-click` on every platform; the existing `isMacPlatform` helper shows ⌘-click on macOS and Ctrl-click on Windows and Linux.
- [#22287](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22287) fix(web): align sidebar button geometry with shared tokens · `UtkarshUsername` · +2/-2 · updated 2026-10-20 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Small and large sidebar buttons (including Settings search results) use hardcoded padding and radius; they move to the shared `--sidebar-row-content-inset` and `--control-radius` tokens without changing height or type.
- [#21878](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/21878) fix(web): edit from here uses a pencil icon · `voltcrash` · +2/-2 · updated 2026-10-19 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  The 'Edit from here' button on user messages uses `Undo2Icon`, which reads as undo or reply; it becomes a pencil icon for the edit action.
- [#24567](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24567) fix(web): scale inline code to Markdown table text · `juliusmarminge` · +5/-0 · updated 2026-10-24 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Inline code in Markdown table cells renders at the same 12px as the surrounding text; it is sized at 0.875em relative to the cell, leaving paragraph and fenced code unchanged.
- [#23740](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23740) fix(mobile): name iOS environment buttons for VoiceOver · `only21mil` · +5/-0 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with GPT-6.1 Sol in T3 Code Nightly
  On iOS the icon-only Reconnect and Remove environment actions expose as generic 'refresh' and 'trash' elements; they get button roles and the same names Android already uses.
- [#22385](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22385) fix(web): lineage list no longer shifts when "Show more" makes it scroll · `FllipEis` · +3/-2 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  Lineage list rows shift when 'Show more' makes the list overflow and a classic scrollbar appears; the existing `scrollbar-gutter-stable` utility reserves the gutter. This is a takeover of an earlier PR with the original commits preserved.
- [#22418](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22418) fix(mobile): iOS terminal's Attach visible output clears the home indicator · `Claudesaul` · +4/-1 · updated 2026-10-20 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  On iPhone the 'Attach visible output' button sits under the home indicator; its bottom padding adds the safe-area bottom inset, from the same source the screen uses for its top inset.
- [#14482](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/14482) refactor(desktop): Drop the unused Linux --class switch · `mwolson` · +0/-6 · updated 2026-10-24 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Drops the stale `--class=t3code` Chromium switch on Linux: since Electron 43 the window class comes from `setDesktopName`, so the switch no longer sets it and misleads launcher WM classes.
- [#23468](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23468) fix(azure-devops): file comments name the path the diff shows · `only21mil` · +3/-3 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol in T3 Code Nightly
  On Azure DevOps, file-pinned comments carry a leading slash in `threadContext.filePath` and match no diff file; the path is normalised the same way changed files already are.
- [#23348](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23348) fix(mobile): review file navigation respects reduced motion · `unmanbearpig` · +5/-1 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Mobile Review changes still animates file selection and back-to-top with Android system animations off; both native scroll commands now honour `useReducedMotion()`.
- [#22532](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22532) fix(desktop): preserve deleted Start Menu shortcuts on auto-update · `zainmitchell` · +5/-1 · updated 2026-10-20 · draft: no · screenshots/video: no · attribution: none
  Auto-updates recreate a Start Menu shortcut the user deleted, because the `customInstall` repair runs after electron-builder's preservation; the repair runs only on user-run installs.
- [#20003](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/20003) fix(web): settings scope pickers stay in reach while you scroll · `ashx-j` · +3/-3 · updated 2026-10-19 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  The project and environment scope pickers in Settings scroll out of reach on long pages; they stay pinned above the rows with an opaque background, with scroll padding for focused settings.
- [#21592](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/21592) fix(desktop): declare Calendar access for hosted commands · `Lenoridev` · +6/-0 · updated 2026-10-19 · draft: no · screenshots/video: no · attribution: none
  EventKit-based commands fail without a permission prompt from the macOS desktop app because its Info.plist lacks Calendar usage descriptions; the descriptions are added to the existing packaging config.
- [#23956](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23956) fix(web): restart-to-update icon no longer shows a stray dot · `shurkanTwo` · +5/-2 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  The restart-to-update sidebar icon shows a stray dot above the check badge, because the start of the RotateCw arc peeks past the badge ring; the arc geometry is adjusted.
- [#21054](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/21054) fix(desktop): start the WSL backend in the Linux home, not /mnt/c · `SunkenInTime` · +7/-0 · updated 2026-10-21 · draft: no · screenshots/video: no · attribution: none
  The WSL backend inherits the Windows working directory (/mnt/c), so provider discovery scans the Windows home over drvfs; `--cd ~` makes it start in the Linux home.
- [#24248](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24248) docs: keybindings guide names the real when key and queue command · `MarcoDotIO` · +5/-3 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: no · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  Docs-only: `docs/user/keybindings.md` lists a `composerDraft` when-context key that no client sets and names the wrong queue shortcut; the guide is corrected to the real keys.
- [#22795](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22795) fix(web): font picker scrolls to every font in short windows · `Byntham` · +6/-2 · updated 2026-10-21 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  The font picker in short windows stops at a cut-off font; scrolling now reaches every entry. Before/after GIFs are in the body.
- [#22550](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22550) fix(mobile): iPad sidebar no longer hides its first thread before iOS 26 · `Neilsmahajan` · +4/-5 · updated 2026-10-24 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  On iPadOS 18 the split-view sidebar hides its newest thread under the title bar and Search field; the list starts below the sidebar header so the first row is visible.
- [#22367](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22367) fix(web): keep markdown separators visible in dark mode · `Zlash65` · +7/-2 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Markdown horizontal rules blend into dark composer and message backgrounds (notably the T3 Chat theme); they are made visible in both the composer and rendered messages.
- [#22497](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22497) fix(desktop): stop the macOS Settings tracker when T3 exits · `only21mil` · +8/-1 · updated 2026-10-20 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Opus 5.5 in T3 Code Nightly
  The macOS permission helper runs one long-lived `osascript` loop; if T3's main process dies without cleanup, the loop keeps polling System Settings every 0.5 s. The PR addresses the orphaned-tracker case.
- [#23155](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23155) fix(mobile): disabled send button is readable in Material You dark · `RVZO6` · +8/-2 · updated 2026-10-25 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
  In Material You dark the disabled send button is nearly invisible: the icon uses `onPrimary` at 15% opacity over a dark surface; the disabled state moves to the Material 3 disabled colours.
- [#22465](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22465) fix(desktop): keep remote browser host tabs paintable · `pablo-kitz` · +7/-3 · updated 2026-10-24 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Connecting the Mac desktop app to a Windows-hosted environment leaves the remote browser on 'Connecting...', because the suspended host webview is moved off-screen and stops compositing; the remote browser is kept paintable.
- [#23136](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23136) fix(web): keep theme color alpha when a hex value is typed · `only21mil` · +9/-1 · updated 2026-10-21 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Opus 5.5 in T3 Code Nightly
  In the theme editor's colour popover, typing a HEX value drops the alpha channel of a translucent theme colour (RGB and sliders keep it); the HEX path is fixed to keep alpha.
- [#21383](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/21383) fix(mobile): usage chart bars round at the top instead of the bottom · `adityavardhansharma` · +8/-2 · updated 2026-10-19 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  On Android the Usage daily chart bars are rounded at the bottom and square at the top, because the rounding clips a full-height column; the clipping is fixed so each bar's top corners round.
- [#22100](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22100) fix(web): respect reduced motion in thread loading controls · `saphid` · +6/-5 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Thread merge and stop controls use raw spinning icons that bypass the shared reduced-motion and visibility safeguards; they become the existing Spinner at the same size.
- [#24147](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24147) fix(copy): clarify provider errors and recovery · `extoci` · +6/-6 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Provider banners use vague states such as 'unauthenticated' and 'limited availability'; the copy is rewritten in plain language on web and mobile, and expired approval requests explain why they can no longer be answered.
- [#24084](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24084) fix(web): keep the wide table scrollbar visible when it overflows · `fixfon` · +12/-0 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: no · attribution: none
  In a narrow chat lane, a wide markdown table's horizontal scrollbar only shows on hover, so hidden columns can look complete; a visible overflow cue is added (#16091).
- [#24773](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24773) fix(web): terminal output no longer edits a hidden question draft · `juliusmarminge` · +11/-2 · updated 2026-10-25 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  With a custom-answer question open, 'Add to chat' for terminal output overwrote the hidden ordinary draft; the insert is rejected and a notice asks the user to answer or dismiss the question.
- [#23538](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23538) fix(mobile): strip image and link punctuation from subagent previews · `only21mil` · +11/-2 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with GPT-6.1 Sol in T3 Code Nightly
  Mobile subagent previews drop Markdown punctuation when a result contains an image or a link with parentheses in its destination; the shared formatter used by the transcript row and Agents sheet is corrected.
- [#22420](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22420) fix(mobile): review's empty state stays below the header on iOS · `Claudesaul` · +12/-1 · updated 2026-10-20 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  On iOS, opening Review changes before the diff is cached can leave the 'No changes' card under the header with a blank area below; a RefreshControl-driven inset change is kept from leaking into the layout.
- [#22568](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22568) fix(mobile): Android file link pills are no longer squished · `RVZO6` · +7/-7 · updated 2026-10-25 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
  Since #18735 Android draws file link pills with inline-code text at about half width; the Enriched Markdown dependency's no-break-space padding is fixed, affecting most file links in chat.
- [#24385](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/24385) fix(mobile): confirm before stopping background work from the floating capsule · `VendettaGhub` · +13/-1 · updated 2026-10-24 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  On mobile, tapping Stop in the floating background-work capsule now opens the existing confirm dialog ('Stop background work?') and only the confirmation runs the stop action.
- [#18158](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/18158) fix(mobile): preserve Duo search text across layout changes · `PixPMusic` · +13/-1 · updated 2026-10-19 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  Maintainer note: the branch is superseded by current main and leaves zero diff, so no replacement patch is proposed. Listed for completeness; not a live UI change.
- [#23888](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23888) fix(mobile): models stay visible in the picker with Android animations removed · `shivamhwp` · +12/-3 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
  On Android with 'Remove animations' on, the model picker in thread settings shows blank gaps where models should be; the author says some of the verification is unproven on device.
- [#22835](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22835) fix(desktop): browser tabs no longer report loopback access as denied · `afrojun` · +15/-2 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code using Claude Opus 5.5
  Okta sign-in in the built-in browser stops at 'Okta FastPass requires network permission'; Electron never asks the preview session for loopback-network permission and the handler answers denied.
- [#18848](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/18848) refactor(mobile): look up viewed pull request files with a Set · `saphid` · +8/-9 · updated 2026-10-23 · draft: no · screenshots/video: no · attribution: none
  The viewed-files hook scans the viewed-state array per lookup; it builds a memoised Set once per server answer. Internal cleanup, no UI change.
- [#23893](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23893) fix(web): mark the selected diff scope in its menu · `shethshlok` · +14/-3 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: none
  In the diff scope menu a hovered neighbouring row looks like the selected row and nothing marks the active choice; the existing `MenuRadioItemIndicator` is added to the scope and per-turn options.
- [#23688](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23688) fix(mobile): keep source text bold for numeric font weights · `only21mil` · +16/-1 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with GPT-6.1 Sol in T3 Code Nightly
  In the iOS Source view, bold text looks lighter than the file viewer because numeric font weight 700 maps to the semibold enum; the weight mapping is corrected.
- [#22843](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22843) fix(mobile): sent messages no longer stay in the iOS composer after IME input · `nabettu` · +12/-5 · updated 2026-10-21 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  On iOS, sending while the keyboard holds uncommitted IME text (e.g. Japanese kana) delivers the message but leaves the typed text in the composer, which is then saved as a draft.
- [#23141](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23141) fix(desktop): clicking inside the in-app browser closes open host menus · `voida6` · +17/-1 · updated 2026-10-25 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  In the desktop in-app browser, clicking inside the page while the three-dot preview menu is open leaves the menu open; the cause is that on real OS clicks the guest page often never takes focus.
- [#23573](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23573) fix(web): single-digit numbered lists no longer clip in wide fonts · `juliusmarminge` · +8/-10 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code — Claude Opus 5.5 (lead, implement, review, proof audit, evidence) and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (review), driven from T3
  With wide interface fonts such as Monocraft, the leading digit of single-digit numbered lists is clipped because the fixed 1.25rem marker gutter is too narrow; the gutter is widened.
- [#23723](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23723) fix(web): show rounded diff counts as 1m instead of 1000k · `only21mil` · +15/-3 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with GPT-6.1 Sol in T3 Code Nightly
  Diff counts from 999,500 to 999,999 render as '+1000k' instead of rounding to the million tier; the tier boundaries are fixed for additions, deletions and billions.
- [#21691](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/21691) fix(mobile): Android composer's send row no longer hides behind the taskbar with a hardware keyboard · `shivamhwp` · +14/-4 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  On Android with the IME visible, the composer's send row can hide behind the taskbar; the author says the tablet case is inferred and the current version has not been run on a phone.
- [#23166](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/23166) fix(web): enable Send when the composer holds only a thread context · `only21mil` · +17/-1 · updated 2026-10-22 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Opus 5.5 in T3 Code Nightly
  When the composer holds only an attached thread-context chip, the Send button is disabled while Enter still sends the draft; enablement is aligned with the Enter rule.
- [#22771](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/22771) fix(web): composer drafts keep underscores in non-Latin names · `yzn-h` · +16/-2 · updated 2026-10-21 · draft: no · screenshots/video: mentioned · attribution: Generated with Claude Code
  When the composer rebuilds a stored draft, an underscore between two non-ASCII letters is read as emphasis (e.g. Arabic or Cyrillic file names), mangling the text sent to the agent.

- Changed-file lists for the 39 PRs that returned exactly 100 paths may be capped by gh: #5178, #8766, #14617, #14882, #16047, #16048, #16049, #16050, #16051, #16053, #16054, #16055, #16056, #16057, #16058, #16061, #16062, #16063, #16065, #16731, #18338, #18456, #18594, #19553, #19576, #19703, #20056, #20753, #20754, #20755, #20756, #21869, #23984, #24215, #24285, #24586, #24825, #24826, #24827, #24863. Their path-based UI flags could be incomplete; not re-verified.
- Diffs were not read for any PR. UI relevance is a title, label and changed-path heuristic, so some false positives are likely (e.g. "copy", "label", "tab", "light" matches).
- PR bodies were read only for the 60 shortlisted PRs (first ~420 characters for the summary, full body checked for media and attribution). The other 2,160 PRs were classified from title, labels and paths only.
- Not fetched, out of scope: review state, CI checks, comments, mergeability, linked issues.
- Shortlist is a ranking heuristic, not a sampled or graded set.
- Three titles containing "@" had it replaced with a fullwidth character so they do not read as mentions.
